languageModel.argument: The sentence contains the conjunction 'and' connecting a course code and a descriptive text phrase. According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:requires, this represents a set of requirements where every item must be satisfied. Therefore, the structure is an 'all_of' node containing the specific course 'CHEM 26103' and the condition 'related course component drill for CHEM 26103'. The definition of ceterms:alternativeCondition is not applicable because 'and' implies necessity of all parts, whereas 'or' would imply sufficiency of any single part.
